interpretation_warnings: Funeral social norms and disposal practices are contextual historical materials; no personal legal/clinical/public-health advice.
Post-event timely/untimely assessments are not prospectively accurate death forecasts.
The 199 and 2920 totals derive from different procedures, not competing source-edition readings of a single count.
White/black categories are context sensitive: colors cannot be collapsed into one universal success label.
No actual human case outcomes were collected/used.
